contracts.source: Schrödinger press release: Schrdinger Announces Strategic Collaboration and Software (08-05-2026)
contracts.signal: Under the strategic agreement, Schrödinger will collaborate with BMS scientists on developing novel functionality within Bunsen, in conjunction with its large-scale chemical-exploration technologies and RetroSynth, its AI-driven synthesis planning platform. The release calls BMS a long-standing customer that routinely uses Schrödinger's computational platform; Chief Scientific Officer Robert Abel: 'We are thrilled they are deploying Bunsen at a large scale.'
contracts.units: joint development of new Bunsen functionality; large-scale Bunsen deployment
